title: Save the exact normalized-and-corrupted ORION front tensor as a diagnostic image
reason: The legacy rgb_front_model_input image is reconstructed from the Q20 sensor frame and does not exactly represent global blur/dark or tensor-space local corruptions. Future visual audits need an image derived directly from the tensor passed to ORION.

behavior.source: input_data_batch['img'][0] after any synthetic corruption and immediately before ORION model execution
behavior.conversion: reverse frozen RGB normalization, convert RGB to BGR, round and clamp to uint8
behavior.cadence: existing diagnostic save cadence only, every 10 agent steps

claim_boundary: This change improves visual provenance only. It does not alter ORION inputs, outputs, control, uncertainty, training targets or any safety result.
